author: Krono III
title: Algo Arc 2.1: PPO Epsilon Tuning (0.3)
abstract: This experiment completes my tuning of the clip_epsilon hyperparameter. The baseline (0.2) scored 85.3, and my test of a conservative value (0.1) scored 85.1. I will now test a more aggressive value of 0.3 to determine if larger policy updates are beneficial or detrimental.
